params.body:
Closes #1039

On 22 October 2026 at 05:49 the connection to smtp.resend.com:587 timed out while `stocklist:dailyexport` sent one dealer's digest (Nightwatch #67). The per-recipient catch (R B1-2.16) reported it and the round went on, but the task runs once a day, so that dealer had no digest until the next morning.

- `DailyExports::send` wraps the send in Laravel's `retry()`: two attempts, ten seconds apart, and only for a `TransportExceptionInterface`. When the second attempt fails, the existing catch reports it and moves on as before.
- Faults that are not the transport (a template that throws) are not retried.
- New rule R B1-2.17 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/21-b1-biedingen.md`.
- `DailyMailRetriesATransportFaultTest`: timeout then success (sent and recorded, one sleep, nothing reported), two timeouts (not recorded, reported, exit 0), a non-transport fault (no second try).

Possible side effect: if a timeout ever lands after the server accepted the message, the dealer may get the digest twice. A duplicate costs less than a lost day.

Full suite locally: 3140 tests, no failures.
params.title: Give a daily digest one more try after a mail transport fault
